title: Titanium Air Sparger Pipe
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this tank hardware application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by perforated air agitation sparger pipe and specific design requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for tank hardware geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with 0.5mm corner radius
Pickling and passivation with 0.5mm corner radius
Continuity test <1 mOhm with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for perforated air agitation application
commonFailures: Uneven coating from current density variation - corrected by auxiliary anode 50mm from cathode — critical for perforated air agitation performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Air Sparger Pipe suitable for Perforated air agitation sparger pipe?
faq.a: Titanium Air Sparger Pipe uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address tank hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Air Sparger Pipe?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Air Sparger Pipe is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for perforated air agitation requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Air Sparger Pipe require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. perforated air agitation components require Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for perforated air agitation application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Air Sparger Pipe shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Air Sparger Pipe includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet perforated air agitation specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Sparger / Air sparge tank hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
